scope: Finite-matrix factor-8 mean-swirl co-design candidate only; no moment feasibility, full stress cone, time integration, nonlinear transfer, or Navier--Stokes acceptance.

optimization.seeds: zero, first-order growth directions at multipliers 0.1/1/10, and four deterministic Gaussian directions
optimization.cone_constraints: 22 solve_control eta/y locations with lambda2 >= 1 percent of the baseline lambda2 included in SLSQP and reported

best_attempt.rejection_reason: No cone-constrained trial met both the growth target and the 1 percent baseline lambda2 floor; this is an optimizer result, not an infeasibility claim.
best_attempt.selection_reason: Largest minimum normalized cone margin among recorded constrained trials.
